title: QR Beam
subtitle: Send a small file with no network at all — screen to camera.
sendDesc: Turn a file into a stream of QR codes the other device scans.
receiveDesc: Point your camera at the other device's QR stream.
hint: Works with no Wi-Fi, hotspot, or Bluetooth. Best for text, keys, and small documents — larger files are slow.
sendEmpty: Pick a small file and BIShare turns it into a looping QR stream. Point the other device's camera at your screen to receive it.
errTooLarge: Too large for QR Beam (max {max}). Use nearby or a link for bigger files.
keepSteady: Keep both screens steady and facing each other until it finishes.
largeWarn: Larger files take longer — keep the cameras aligned.
cameraError: Camera unavailable. Check permissions and try again.
unsupported: Your browser can't scan QR streams. Try Chrome or Edge, or have them show while you scan from a phone.
aimHint: Point your camera at the other device showing the QR codes.
